svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-29
svg.desc: Graph actions, data-driven effects, waits, migration planning, and cleanup.
svg.text: 2026-07-29 - Graph actions, effects, waits, and cleanup
main | 9 commits: 54a7e90, 5c1251f, c0eb1e7, 5c0d41a, 38b082a, 144d96b, 2918713, c6eff50, df52ad2
Daily job
Fill the graph vocabulary with gameplay verbs and prepare data-driven migration work.
Targeting, XML definitions, damage fallback, GameplayEffects.json, Wait, plans, scripts, and cache cleanup changed.
BEFORE
Small graph vocabulary
No FaceTarget or reusable Wait action.
Effect behavior was less data-driven.
Editor caches and plans obscured the path.
FireBolt timing and damage composition
were harder to read as a graph.
AFTER
Composed actions and data-backed effects
FaceTarget, Wait, FireBolt/FireGun XML, and toolbar/editor support are present.
C++ default damage fallback and GameplayEffects.json feed effect behavior.
A one-second FireBolt wait makes montage timing explicit.
Migration plans, helper scripts, and cache cleanup clarify the working set.
Guard: nodes are small verbs; definitions compose them; GAS applies effects.
Important guard
Do not bury timing or damage rules in one
monolithic node. Keep action, definition, and
effect source distinguishable.
Validation / newcomer path
Follow XML -> registered node -> task -> GAS effect.
Read the migration plan and smoke helper after
checking the graph runtime code.
